title: The balanced two-way layout
html:
Assume @eq-tw-cell-means with a,b≥2 and m≥2, and let αi, βj, γij be the equal-weight effects of @def-tw-interaction.

  1. The five matrices @eq-tw-five-projections are mutually orthogonal projections that sum to I, with ranks 1, a−1, b−1, (a−1)(b−1) and ab(m−1). The projection onto C(X) is M=P0+PA+PB+PAB, and that onto the additive model space is P0+PA+PB. So C(PAB) is the orthogonal complement of the additive model within the cell-means model.

  2. The projections act by (PAy)ijk=y¯i⋅⋅−y¯⋅⋅⋅,(PABy)ijk=y¯ij⋅−y¯i⋅⋅−y¯⋅j⋅+y¯⋅⋅⋅,(PEy)ijk=yijk−y¯ij⋅, and symmetrically for PB. The sums of squares are SSA=bm∑i(y¯i⋅⋅−y¯⋅⋅⋅)2,SSB=am∑j(y¯⋅j⋅−y¯⋅⋅⋅)2,SSAB=m∑i,j(y¯ij⋅−y¯i⋅⋅−y¯⋅j⋅+y¯⋅⋅⋅)2,SSE=∑i,j,k(yijk−y¯ij⋅)2.

  3. The mean squares have expectations EMSA=σ2+bma−1∑iαi2,EMSB=σ2+amb−1∑jβj2,EMSAB=σ2+m(a−1)(b−1)∑i,jγij2,EMSE=σ2.

  4. Under normal errors the four sums of squares are independent, SSE/σ2∼χ2(ab(m−1)), and FA=MSAMSE∼F(a−1,ab(m−1),bmσ2∑iαi2),FAB=MSABMSE∼F((a−1)(b−1),ab(m−1),mσ2∑i,jγij2), and likewise for FB. So FAB is an exact test of additivity, FA of μ¯1⋅=⋯=μ¯a⋅, and FB of μ¯⋅1=⋯=μ¯⋅b.

  5. SSA is the sum of squares of the hypothesis α1=⋯=αa=0 in the cell-means model. It is also the sequential sum of squares of A whether A is entered before or after B, and it equals the Type II and Type III sums of squares of A. The same holds for B, and SSAB is the sequential, Type II and Type III sum of squares of the interaction.
